name: input-group
purpose: Composition container that joins an input primitive with any number of adjacent controls (buttons, selects, static addons) into a single visual field — the webkit analogue of PrimeVue's `InputGroup`. The root only orchestrates: it draws the outer border, the `focus-within` ring, and applies inline Tailwind child-selectors so the first child rounds only on the left, the last only on the right, and internal borders collapse between siblings. Everything else is a **child**: the middle input is a raw `<input>` in the root's `default` slot; sibling controls (`<Button>`, `<Select>`, `<Input>`, or an `<InputGroup.Addon>` for static text like `https://` / `.com` / `R$`) are dropped in directly alongside it. This is a breaking change from v3: the `#left` and `#right` named slots are gone — their static-text role moves to `<InputGroup.Addon>`, and their interactive role is served by placing the real component (`Button`, `Select`) as a direct child. Consumers therefore never wrap `Button`/`Select` in an inner `<div>` — the root's child selectors do that job.
useWhen: A text input that needs static prefix or suffix content inside the same border (`https://`, `.com`, a currency symbol).
An input joined to a control: a search field with a trailing `button`, an amount with a leading currency `select`.
avoidWhen: A phone number with a dial code → use `phone-input`.
A single input with only a decorative icon → use `input` and its `iconLeft` / `iconRight` slots.
related: field` — wrap the group in a `Field` for a label and description/error; `InputGroup.Input` takes the field's id, `aria-describedby` and state, and the root takes `invalid` / `disabled` / `required` from it.
phone-input` — input group with a dial-code select and a per-country mask.
input` — the single-field primitive with icon slots.
bestPractices: Put static text and icons in `InputGroup.Addon`; place real controls (`button`, `select`) as direct children with no wrapper `div`.
Set the same `size` on the group and on its child controls so heights line up.

disabled`, `invalid`, and `required` style the group only; also set them on every child control they should affect. Inside a `Field`, put them on the `Field` instead: the root and `InputGroup.Input` both read them.
Use `InputGroup.Input` for the middle input: it is borderless, picks up the enclosing `Field`'s wiring, and spares the long raw-`<input>` class string.
The root is `role="group"`; label the inner input itself, or give the group an `aria-label`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size token; affects the root's height and inner addon padding. Heights: small=28px, medium=32px, large=40px. Matches the sibling input primitives (`Input`, `Select`) — set the same `size` on child controls to keep them visually aligned.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Renders the error border and sets `aria-invalid="true"` on the root.

props.name: required
props.doc: Renders the required (warning) border. `aria-required` is not allowed on `role="group"`, so the required state belongs on the input (`InputGroup.Input` reads it from the Field).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Renders the disabled visual (muted fill, not-allowed cursor, no focus-within ring) and sets `aria-disabled="true"` on the root. Does not propagate to the child controls — each child is responsible for its own `disabled` attribute (inside a `Field`, the Field's `disabled` reaches both the root and `InputGroup.Input`).

slots.name: default
slots.notes: On the **root**: the full row of children in visual order — any mix of `<InputGroup.Addon>`, `<Button>`, `<Select>`, `<Input>`, raw `<input>`. Order in the template is the order rendered left-to-right. On **`<InputGroup.Addon>`**: the addon content — text (`https://`, `.com`, `R$`), a PrimeIcons `<i>`, or any small inline node; kept short by convention (long content breaks the fixed row height).

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import InputGroupRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/input-group-root'
</script>

<template>
  <InputGroupRoot>
    <input
      placeholder="domain"
      class="flex-1 min-w-0 h-full bg-(--bg-surface) border-0 outline-none focus:ring-0 px-(--spacing-md) text-label-sm text-(--text-default) placeholder:text-(--text-muted)"
    />
  </InputGroupRoot>
</template>

examples.name: Sizes
WithAddonLeft
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import InputGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/input-group'
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import Select from '@aziontech/webkit/select'
</script>

<template>
  <InputGroup>
    <InputGroup.Addon>https://</InputGroup.Addon>
    <input
      placeholder="domain"
      class="flex-1 min-w-0 h-full bg-(--bg-surface) border-0 outline-none focus:ring-0 px-(--spacing-md) text-label-sm text-(--text-default) placeholder:text-(--text-muted)"
    />
  </InputGroup>
</template>
